# Server Port
PORT=5000
NODE_ENV=development

# Database Configuration (MySQL XAMPP default)
DB_HOST=localhost
DB_PORT=3306
DB_USER=root
DB_PASS=
DB_NAME=db_dafa_archive

# JWT Secret
JWT_SECRET=daf_archive_smk_diponegoro_cipari_secret_key_2026_thesis_secure_jwt

# File Upload Directory
UPLOAD_DIR=uploads

{
  "name": "daf-archive-backend",

  "description": "Backend API untuk Sistem Penyimpanan Arsip Digital Terpusat (DAF Archive) SMK Diponegoro Cipari",

  "scripts": {
    "start": "node src/server.js",
    "dev": "node --watch src/server.js",
    "init-db": "node src/scripts/initDb.js"
  },
  "keywords": [
    "archive",
    "smk-diponegoro-cipari",
    "express",
    "mysql",
    "rbac",
    "snp"

  "author": "SMK Diponegoro Cipari",

  "dependencies": {
    "archiver": "^7.0.1",
    "bcryptjs": "^2.4.3",

    "cors": "^2.8.5",
    "dotenv": "^16.4.5",
    "express": "^4.19.2",
    "jsonwebtoken": "^9.0.2",
    "morgan": "^1.10.0",
